AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Explicitly granted event administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

AdminInvite.title: AdminInvite
AdminInvite.description: Email-based co-organizer authorization keyed by normalized email identifier.

email.description: Lowercase Google email address of the authorized co-organizer.

note.description: Optional label or office responsibility note for the co-organizer.

invitedBy.description: Firebase Auth UID of the admin who added this co-organizer.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when co-organizer access was granted.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private employee profile containing email PII, readable only by owner or admin.

office.description: Office location of the participant (Taipei or Hsinchu).

EventConfig.title: EventConfig
EventConfig.description: Global scoring rules and 7-sticker campaign metadata managed by event organizers.

basePoints.description: Base points awarded for finding and uploading each sticker (0 to 1000).

topN.description: Number of fastest uploaders per sticker eligible for speed bonus (1 to 50).

topNBonus.description: Extra bonus points awarded to each of the fastest Top N uploaders per sticker (0 to 2000).

stickerNames.description: Ordered list of 7 gingerbread sticker names.

stickerHints.description: Ordered list of 7 optional clue hints (default / Taipei).

stickerHintsTaipei.description: Ordered list of 7 clue hints for Taipei office.

stickerHintsHsinchu.description: Ordered list of 7 clue hints for Hsinchu office.

eventStartDate.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date of Day 1 used to unlock next-day clear photos in the gallery.

StickerSubmission.title: StickerSubmission
StickerSubmission.description: Publicly visible event entry for one of the 7 gingerbread stickers, without PII.

office.description: Office location track for scoring and prize awards.

stickerDay.description: Integer between 1 and 7 representing which gingerbread sticker was found.

rejectionReason.description: Reason provided by an admin when marking a submission as rejected.

/adminInvites/{inviteId}.description: Email-based co-organizer invitations for helpers before or after first login.

/users/{userId}.description: Private employee profile (contains email PII, owner/admin only).

/eventConfig/{configId}.description: Event scoring configuration and 7-sticker titles/clues (doc ID: main).

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Daily gingerbread sticker photo uploads and tagged colleague names.
